papers.title_en: On concatenation of matrices for reversible linear codes over a finite commutative ring and applications to DNA codes
papers.evidence: 从Z4上的循环码构造二进制量子码，与量子纠错编码相关
papers.tldr: 本文针对有限交换环上可逆线性码的构造问题，提出一种基于对合矩阵的矩阵连接方案。该方法通过矩阵乘积实现线性码的广义拼接，统一构造了可逆线性码、可逆变偶码和可逆DNA码，并得到参数良好的生成矩阵族。同时，解决了Oztas等人提出的开放问题，纠正并改进了部分结果。该工作为DNA码的设计提供了新的代数框架。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop a generalized framework for constructing reversible linear, reversible self dual and reversible DNA codes using a matrix-theoretic approach based on involutory matrices. The proposed concatenation scheme gives a large class of generator matrices and yields codes with good parameters. The construction is carried out at the level of linear codes and then extended to DNA codes. Using a matrix product approach, we provide a unified method for analysis and proof. Further, we resolve an open problem raised by Oztas et.al. and also we correct and improve some results of them.

papers.tldr: 纠错码是条码扫描、清晰通话、可靠存储、卫星通信和量子计算的基础。本手册是《纠错码动物园》的精简版，收录了保护经典或量子信息免于存储和传输错误的各类编码方法。它提供编码的详细描述与符号分类，并编录了码间关系及与球堆积、格、设计、群、物质相等相关对象的联系。旨在作为严谨参考和追踪码关系网络的实用工具，帮助研究人员发现新连接。
papers.abstract_en: Barcode scans, clear phone calls, reliable data storage, satellite communication, and large-scale quantum computation are all made possible by error correction. We present a handbook version of The Error Correction Zoo, a curated reference of methods for protecting classical or quantum information from errors during storage and transmission. The handbook includes descriptions of these error-correcting codes and a classification according to the symbols they use. It also catalogues relations among codes and related objects such as sphere packings, lattices, designs, groups, and classical and quantum phases of matter. The collection is intended both as a rigorous reference and as a practical aid for tracing the web of code relationships and uncovering new connections.
